condRuzsaDist.statement: Let $G$ be a countable abelian group in which singletons are measurable. For random variables $X:\Omega\to G$, $Z:\Omega\to S$ and $Y:\Omega'\to G$, $W:\Omega'\to T$, and finite measures $\mu$ on $\Omega$ and $\mu'$ on $\Omega'$ (by default the ambient measures), this defines the real number $d[X|Z \,;\, Y|W]$, the conditional Ruzsa distance of $X$ given $Z$ (with respect to $\mu$) and $Y$ given $W$ (with respect to $\mu'$).

condRuzsaDist'.statement: Let $G$ be a countable abelian group in which singletons are measurable. For random variables $X:\Omega\to G$ and $Y:\Omega'\to G$, $W:\Omega'\to T$, a measure $\mu$ on $\Omega$ and a finite measure $\mu'$ on $\Omega'$ (by default the ambient measures), this defines the real number $d[X \,;\, Y|W]$, the conditional Ruzsa distance between $X$ (with respect to $\mu$) and $Y$ given $W$ (with respect to $\mu'$).
